gates.name: Dataset schema integrity
gates.acceptance: 100% of records in a released dataset revision pass its declared versioned schema.

gates.name: Record provenance
gates.acceptance: Every released record has a resolvable source or documented generation provenance and a rights status.

gates.name: Deduplication and leakage
gates.acceptance: Exact and semantic deduplication is reported; train/validation/test leakage is checked; hidden evaluation is isolated.

gates.name: Mathematical verification
gates.acceptance: Every record designated as independently verified has a reproducible verifier, version, output and status.

gates.name: Scientific evidence
gates.acceptance: Evidence-backed outputs trace claims to sources and passage locations; unsupported claims are scored.

gates.name: Baseline comparison
gates.acceptance: Candidate model is compared with both the base model and original Trimorious checkpoint on the same frozen benchmark.

gates.name: Safety and reliability
gates.acceptance: Prompt-injection, malicious-tool, misinformation, privacy, hazardous request and abstention tests are documented with regression outcomes.

gates.name: Reproducible training
gates.acceptance: Complete run manifest includes code/data/model revisions, seeds, dependencies, hardware and training arguments.

gates.name: Inference compatibility
gates.acceptance: Tokenizer, chat template, generation config, local inference and declared serving formats pass documented smoke tests.

gates.name: Deployment performance
gates.acceptance: Latency, throughput, memory and quantization behavior are measured on stated hardware and workload.

gates.name: Licensing and redistribution
gates.acceptance: Base model, adapter, source datasets, papers, code and derivative materials have a documented compatible rights decision.

gates.name: Documentation and rollback
gates.acceptance: Model/dataset cards, citation metadata, release notes, checksums and rollback instructions are published.
